summary: Blocking: update's is_idle requires .data.kernel.running == false, but kernel.running reflects whether forest serve holds the workspace lock (main.go kernelView.Running = state.LockHeld), so it is true for a live instance. The idle-window wait therefore never succeeds while the service runs and update aborts after idle_timeout_seconds (300s). The check must detect no live Runs (all triggers running == false) while the Kernel is running, not require the Kernel to be stopped. Reproduced: the jq expression exits 1 for kernel.running=true with every trigger running=false. Also blocking: the post-restart audit_ready wait passively polls status for a fresh audit pass, but the Auditor runs only after a completed dispatch (ADR 0011; docs/onboarding-managed-repo.md). On an instance whose forest.yaml has no always-dispatching agent, no audit runs after restart and update aborts after audit_timeout_seconds (1800s); it should force a fresh audit (e.g. ./forest audit show --rescan) and verify its result. Minor: unused 'active' variable; after rollback the untracked forest.prev is no longer ignored by the restored pre-change .gitignore, so the next update's clean-tree check fails until it is removed.
